parts/room-26.mjs writes 3 blocks inside the box only; make.sh finishes with a whole build.nbt and no REFUSED or off-palette writes.
The walk verdict is UNREACHABLE for this room, but that comes from the whole of plot 3 being cut off (fittings and shell B are still stubs here), not from the room's own cells.
left: Walkability cannot be confirmed from here: all P3 rooms read 'no way in' because the front door and porch (fittings) and shell B are stubs in this copy, so no route reaches plot 3 from the lane.

The stairs/ladder part puts the ladder hatch (open spruce_trapdoor, facing west) at (44,13,9), the belvedere's standing cell, not at (44,12,9) as plan.md's TABLES say. The room's only entry cell is therefore occupied; in-game an open trapdoor can be stood in, but the walker counts it as furniture. The stairs owner should confirm or move the hatch.

The room's floor is 3 usable cells (44,8), (45,8)... (45,8) holds the post, so (44,8) is the only free walkable cell besides the seat at (45,9). A bench for more than one sitter does not fit; the plan's 'lookout' reads as a single lamp and seat.
The belvedere glazing, mullions and copper cap belong to Shell A, Fittings and Roofs; they were not visible in room.png (roof not yet laid), so the look is unverified.
plan.md's checklist and elements.md have no belvedere item, so nothing was ticked.

waste.what: Worked out which of the four floor cells were occupied by reading the plan's 'o' marks, then working out by hand that the 'o' at (44,13,9) is the ladder hatch and not a fitting's shutter, and that the walk problem comes from the stairs part.

waste.tool: mcd plan should print the block id under each 'o' cell (e.g. 'o=spruce_trapdoor'), and the plan's 'o' legend should say which part put it there.

waste.what: Decided by hand which 2x2 cells to fill so the entry and the path stayed clear, with no lamp-spot or walk preview before writing.
waste.cost: 2 build + room check cycles; no blocks placed one by one
waste.tool: mcd room could take a candidate layout (a layers() draft) and report walk and light before it is written to build.nbt.

waste.what: Checked walk reachability and light with separate commands (room, walk --json, fit, plan) and read the walk output per room by hand to see that the failure was plot-wide.
waste.tool: mcd room --rooms could report 'unreachable because the route to the entrance is not built' separately from 'unreachable inside the room', so stubbed neighbouring parts do not look like a failure of this room.

companions.task: Confirm where the ladder hatch sits (plan says (44,12,9), the build has it at (44,13,9)) and move it, or agree that the stand cell with a trapdoor is walkable, so the belvedere's entry is clear.
Check the belvedere's glass panes and birch_fence mullions in the y13..14 band of Shell A and the fittings, so the lookout reads as open on three faces once those parts are built.
Lay the copper cap's underside over the belvedere (the ceiling at y16) so a hanging lantern can replace the standing one on the post, which would free the corner cell.
